summary_en: SK-03 Co. completed a tender offer for CE Holdings shares from August 6 to September 17, 2026, acquiring 7,624,702 shares with the minimum tender threshold of 3,768,300 shares exceeded. CEO Shigeru Sugimoto transferred 1,450,800 shares (excluding 197,800 restricted shares) under a parallel purchase agreement. SK-03 will become the parent company with voting rights exceeding 50% as of September 29, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Company Shares by SK-03 Co., Ltd. and Changes in Parent Company, Major Shareholders, and Lead Major Shareholder
translation_en_brief:
SK-03 Co., Ltd. conducted a tender offer for ordinary shares of CE Holdings Co., Ltd. from August 6 through September 17, 2026. The tender offer was successfully completed with 7,624,702 shares tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 3,768,300 shares. Following the settlement of the tender offer on September 29, 2026, SK-03 will acquire majority voting control of the company.

In parallel with the tender offer, Shigeru Sugimoto, the Company's Representative Director and CEO, entered into a purchase agreement with SK-03 on August 5, 2026, to transfer 1,450,800 of his shares (excluding 197,800 restricted shares) upon successful completion of the tender offer. This parallel transaction was executed as the tender offer conditions were met.

As a result of both the tender offer settlement and the parallel purchase, effective September 29, 2026, SK-03 will become the Company's parent company, major shareholder, and lead major shareholder with voting rights exceeding 50 percent. SK-03's parent companies, SK-02 Co., Ltd. and SK-01 Co., Ltd., will also become parent companies of the Company through their indirect ownership. The existing lead major shareholder, Hikari Communications Co., Ltd., and its co-holders will cease to be major shareholders following these transactions.
